answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the ocean beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is written down in the falcon index and the wander audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 43 keys live and online for the whole period, thus the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 4 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
